description: Use this when an authenticated SIMcloud user asks to send or recharge prepaid airtime to a South African mobile number on MTN, Vodacom, Cell C or Telkom. Confirm the MSISDN, network, rand amount and reference before calling. This spends wallet funds and queues an irreversible external transaction. Never automatically retry an ambiguous result. Duplicate same-MSISDN-and-amount requests inside 5 minutes return HTTP 409.

amount.description: Airtime amount in South African rand, from R2 to R999.

msisdn.description: South African mobile number to recharge, for example 0821234567 or +27821234567.

network.description: Supported South African airtime network name or SIMcloud internal code.

reference.description: User or system reference for this airtime order.

name: create_airtime_order

ok.description: Whether the proxied SIMcloud API request returned a 2xx response.

status.description: HTTP status returned by the SIMcloud API, or 0 when no HTTP response was received.

title: Send South African airtime
